title: Geometry Basics
objectives: Apply area and perimeter formulas for basic shapes
Calculate volume and surface area of simple solids
Use the Pythagorean theorem for right triangles

introduction.context: Planning to paint a room? You'll need to calculate wall area minus windows and doors. Buying carpet? You need floor area. Geometry formulas help us solve these everyday problems!
introduction.connection: Geometry calculations are essential for construction, interior design, packaging, landscaping, and any project involving space and materials.

concepts.title: Area and Perimeter
concepts.content: Perimeter is the distance around the outside of a 2D shape. Area is the amount of space inside a 2D shape, measured in square units.

concepts.title: Pythagorean Theorem
concepts.content: In a right triangle, the square of the hypotenuse equals the sum of squares of the other two sides. This theorem helps us find missing side lengths in right triangles.

examples.problem: Find the area of a rectangle with length 12 ft and width 8 ft
steps: Identify given information: l = 12 ft, w = 8 ft
Apply area formula: A = l × w
commonErrors: Forgetting to include units in the answer
